name: Corpsebound VR
summary: Corpsebound VR challenges you to unleash your inner demon as you face relentless waves of zombies in fast-paced katana combat. Move with precision, strike with power, and cut down the undead before they overwhelm you. Every encounter tests your timing and reflexes in close-quarters VR action. Customize your atmosphere by selecting your own background music directly from the menu, and carve your path through the horde with style. Sharpen your blade — survival demands it.
